A Julia nyelven írt kódod Juliaalapú formális verifikációs eszközökkel vagy általános célú SMT solverekkel tudod formálisan verifikálni.[1]

A kód egy fehérjestruktúrafeldolgozó modul, amely neurális hálózati komponenseket (attention mechanizmusok) és geometriai számításokat tartalmaz. Az ilyen típusú kódok verifikálásához több megközelítés is rendelkezésre áll:[1]

 Juliaspecifikus eszközök

A Satisfiability.jl csomag kiváló választás, amely SMT (Satisfiability Modulo Theories) problémák magas szintű reprezentációját biztosítja Julia nyelven. Ez az eszköz propozicionális logika, egész és valós értékű aritmetika, valamint bitvektorok verifikálására alkalmas, és közvetlenül Juliaban írható specifikációkat használ.[2][3]

A ModelVerification.jl elsősorban neurális hálózatok verifikálására specializálódott eszköz. Mivel a kódod attention mechanizmusokat és neurális hálózati komponenseket tartalmaz, ez különösen releváns lehet. A csomag képes reachability analízisre, viselkedési tulajdonságok ellenőrzésére, és robusztussági tulajdonságok verifikálására CNNek esetében.[4][5][6][1]

 Általános megközelítések

A numerikus számításokat tartalmazó részek esetében (lineáris algebra, mátrixműveletek) intervallumaritmetikát használó eszközök alkalmazhatók formális bizonyítékok konstruálására. A kódod geometriai számításokat (keresztszorzat, normák, távolságok) és SVDt használ, amelyek verifikálása ilyen módszerekkel történhet.[7][1]

Alternatívaként külső SMT solverek (Z3, cvc5) Julia interfészein keresztül is dolgozhatod fel a verifikációs feladatokat, különösen a matematikai invariánsok és algebrai tulajdonságok ellenőrzésére.[3]

 Ajánlás

A kódod komplexitása miatt hibrid megközelítést javaslok: használd a Satisfiability.jlt a matematikai tulajdonságok és invariánsok verifikálására, míg a ModelVerification.jlt a neurális hálózati komponensek (attention rétegek) ellenőrzésére.[5][2][3]

entries.answer:
A Lean 4 az ajánlott választás a lehető legmagasabb minőségű formális verifikációhoz Nixkompatibilis környezetben.[1][2]

 Miért Lean 4?

A Lean 4 jelenleg a legelőrehaladottabb matematikai könyvtárral rendelkezik (mathlib), amely kiterjedt lineáris algebra támogatást nyújt, beleértve mátrixműveleteket, determinánsokat és komplex algebrai struktúrákat. A Julia kódod (mátrixok, SVD, attention mechanizmusok) formalizálásához ezek kritikusak.[3][4][5]

A Lean 4 előnyei a többi proof assistanttal szemben:

Automatizáció: A Lean kiválóan ötvözi az automatizált és interaktív bizonyítási technikákat, modern SMTszerű módszereket implementálva dependent type theory környezetben.[6][7]

Monolitikus könyvtár: A mathlib egyetlen gigantikus repositoryban tartalmazza az összes matematikát, ami elkerüli a verzióütközéseket és megkönnyíti a nagyléptékű refaktorálást. Ez kritikus a komplex neurális hálózati és geometriai kód verifikációjánál.[1]

Metaprogramozás: Lean 4 kiváló metaprogramozási képességekkel rendelkezik, így saját taktikákat és automatizálást írhatsz a verifikációs munkához.[1]

 Alternatívák

Coq szintén erős választás, különösen ha numerikus lineáris algebrát verifikálsz. A CoqMatrix könyvtár kifejezetten mátrixműveletek formalizálására készült. Coqnak nagyobb ökoszisztémája van nemmatematikai projektekhez, és kiforrott Nixtámogatással rendelkezik.[8][9][10][11]

F\ inkább program verifikációra és effectek kezelésére specializálódott, Dijkstra monádokkal. Bár hatékony, a matematikai könyvtára sokkal szegényesebb, mint a Lean 4 mathlibje.[7]

Idris Nixtámogatással rendelkezik, de az ökoszisztémája és könyvtárainak mérete jelentősen elmarad a Lean 4 és Coq mögött.[12]

 Nixkompatibilitás

Mind a Lean 4, mind a Coq kiváló Nixtámogatással rendelkezik. A Coq Nix toolbox kifejezetten reproducibilis környezetek kezelésére készült, CI integrációval és verziókezeléssel. A Lean 4 szintén elérhető nixpkgsben, és aktívan fejlesztett a Nixközösségben.[9][8]

 Végső ajánlás

Lean 4 a Julia kódodhoz, mivel a matematikai könyvtára (mathlib) messze a leggazdagabb lineáris algebra és függvényanalízis területén. A Nixtámogatás mindkét esetben megoldott, de a Lean 4 modernebb architektúrája és aktív fejlesztése előnyt jelent 2025ben.[4][13][2][3]

A Julia kódod maximálisan kiterjedő formális verifikációjának elkészítése Lean 4ben többlépcsős folyamat. Íme a részletes, lépésrőllépésre útmutató:

 Környezet felállítása

 Lean 4 és mathlib telepítése

1. lépés: Elan telepítése
bash
curl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leanprover/elan/master/elan-init.sh -sSf | sh
source ~/.profile


Az elan a Lean verziókezelője, automatikusan kezeli a projektspecifikus Lean verziókat.[1][2]

2. lépés: VS Code és Lean 4 extension
bash
# VS Code telepítése után
code --install-extension leanprover.lean4


A Lean 4 extension interaktív bizonyítási környezetet biztosít.[3]

3. lépés: Új projekt létrehozása mathlib függőséggel
bash
lake +leanprover/lean4:stable new ProteinVerification math
cd ProteinVerification


4. lépés: Mathlib hozzáadása a lakefile.leanhez
lean
require mathlib from git
  "https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4"


5. lépés: Függőségek letöltése
bash
lake exe cache get
lake build


Ez letölti a mathlib előre lefordított verzióját.[4][5]

 A Lean 4 fájl struktúrája

Hozz létre egy ProteinVerification.lean fájlt a következő struktúrával:

 1. Alapvető típusdefiníciók

lean
import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Basic
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Determinant
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic

namespace ProteinVerification

-- Vec3 típus definiálása
structure Vec3 (α : Type*) where
  x : α
  y : α
  z : α

-- Alapvető műveletek Vec3-ra
instance {α : Type*} [Add α] : Add (Vec3 α) where
  add v w := ⟨v.x + w.x, v.y + w.y, v.z + w.z⟩

instance {α : Type*} [Sub α] : Sub (Vec3 α) where
  sub v w := ⟨v.x - w.x, v.y - w.y, v.z - w.z⟩

instance {α : Type*} [Mul α] [Add α] : HMul ℝ (Vec3 α) (Vec3 α) where
  hMul s v := ⟨s * v.x, s * v.y, s * v.z⟩


 2. Specifikációk és invariánsok

lean
-- Keresztszorzat definiálása bizonyítékkal
def cross {α : Type*} [Ring α] (a b : Vec3 α) : Vec3 α :=
  ⟨a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y, 
   a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z, 
   a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x⟩

-- Keresztszorzat tulajdonságai
theorem cross_anticommutative (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : 
  cross a b = -(cross b a) := by
  ext <;> ring

theorem cross_self_zero (a : Vec3 ℝ) : 
  cross a a = 0 := by
  ext <;> ring

-- Skalárszorzat definiálása
def dot {α : Type*} [Mul α] [Add α] (a b : Vec3 α) : α :=
  a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z

-- Skalárszorzat kommutativitása
theorem dot_comm (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : 
  dot a b = dot b a := by
  unfold dot
  ring

-- Normaszámítás
noncomputable def norm (v : Vec3 ℝ) : ℝ := 
  Real.sqrt (dot v v)

-- Norma pozitivitása
theorem norm_nonneg (v : Vec3 ℝ) : 
  0 ≤ norm v := by
  unfold norm
  exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _

-- Norma nullpontossága
theorem norm_eq_zero_iff (v : Vec3 ℝ) : 
  norm v = 0 ↔ v = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    unfold norm at h
    have : dot v v = 0 := Real.sqrt_eq_zero'.mp h
    unfold dot at this
    ext
    · nlinarith [sq_nonneg v.x, sq_nonneg v.y, sq_nonneg v.z]
    · nlinarith [sq_nonneg v.x, sq_nonneg v.y, sq_nonneg v.z]
    · nlinarith [sq_nonneg v.x, sq_nonneg v.y, sq_nonneg v.z]
  · intro h
    simp [h, norm, dot]

 4. Attention mechanizmus verifikációja

lean
-- Softmax függvény specifikációja
noncomputable def softmax {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin n → ℝ :=
  fun i => Real.exp (x i) / ∑ j, Real.exp (x j)

-- Softmax tulajdonságok
theorem softmax_sum_one {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
  ∑ i, softmax x i = 1 := by
  unfold softmax
  rw [Finset.sum_div]
  simp

theorem softmax_nonneg {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
  0 ≤ softmax x i := by
  unfold softmax
  apply div_nonneg
  · exact Real.exp_pos _
  · exact Finset.sum_pos (fun j _ => Real.exp_pos _) Finset.univ_nonempty

-- Attention score számítás
def attention_scores {b h q k d : ℕ}
  (Q : Matrix (Fin b × Fin h × Fin q) (Fin d) ℝ)
  (K : Matrix (Fin b × Fin h × Fin k) (Fin d) ℝ) :
  Matrix (Fin b × Fin h × Fin q) (Fin k) ℝ :=
  fun i j => ∑ l, Q i l * K ⟨i.1, i.2.1, j⟩ l

-- Attention mechanizmus dimenzió-helyessége
theorem attention_preserves_dimensions 
  {b h q k d : ℕ}
  (Q : Matrix (Fin b × Fin h × Fin q) (Fin d) ℝ)
  (K : Matrix (Fin b × Fin h × Fin k) (Fin d) ℝ)
  (V : Matrix (Fin b × Fin h × Fin k) (Fin d) ℝ) :
  ∃ output : Matrix (Fin b × Fin h × Fin q) (Fin d) ℝ, True := by
  use fun i l => ∑ j, softmax (attention_scores Q K i) j * V ⟨i.1, i.2.1, j⟩ l
  trivial

 Maximális verifikációs lefedettség

 Teljes specifikációs stratégia

1. Típusszintű garanciák: Minden függvény típusában fejezd ki a prekondíciókat és posztkondíciókat dependent types használatával.[8]

2. Numerikus stabilitás: Formalizáld az epsilon értékeket és a numerikus hibabecsléseket.[8]

3. Dimenzióhelyesség: Matrix shape invariánsok minden művelethez.[8]

4. Attention mechanizmus: Softmax tulajdonságok (összeg=1, nemnegatív értékek) bizonyítása.[9][10]

5. Geometriai invariánsok: Keresztszorzat, skalárszorzat, ortogonalitás formalizálása.[8]

A mathlib gazdag lineáris algebra könyvtára (Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.*) lehetővé teszi mátrixműveletek, SVD és egyéb numerikus algoritmusok formális verifikáció

import Mathlib.Data.Real.Sqrt
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Basic
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Determinant
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Transpose

import Mathlib.Tactic

open BigOperators Real Matrix

namespace ProteinVerification

/-! # Vec3 Típus és Alapműveletek -/

/-- Háromdimenziós vektor típus -/
structure Vec3 (α : Type*) where
  x : α
  y : α
  z : α
deriving Repr, DecidableEq

namespace Vec3

variable {α : Type*}

/-- Vec3 egyenlőség extensionalitása -/
theorem ext {v w : Vec3 α} (hx : v.x = w.x) (hy : v.y = w.y) (hz : v.z = w.z) : v = w := by
  cases v; cases w
  simp_all only

/-- Összeadás -/
instance [Add α] : Add (Vec3 α) where
  add v w := ⟨v.x + w.x, v.y + w.y, v.z + w.z⟩

/-- Kivonás -/
instance [Sub α] : Sub (Vec3 α) where
  sub v w := ⟨v.x - w.x, v.y - w.y, v.z - w.z⟩

/-- Skaláris szorzás -/
instance [Mul α] : HMul α (Vec3 α) (Vec3 α) where
  hMul s v := ⟨s * v.x, s * v.y, s * v.z⟩

/-- Nullvektor -/
instance [Zero α] : Zero (Vec3 α) where
  zero := ⟨0, 0, 0⟩

/-- Negáció -/
instance [Neg α] : Neg (Vec3 α) where
  neg v := ⟨-v.x, -v.y, -v.z⟩

/-- Keresztszorzat -/
def cross [Ring α] (a b : Vec3 α) : Vec3 α :=
  ⟨a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
   a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
   a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x⟩

/-- Skalárszorzat (dot product) -/
def dot [Mul α] [Add α] (a b : Vec3 α) : α :=
  a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z

/-- Norma négyzete -/
def norm2 (v : Vec3 ℝ) : ℝ := dot v v

/-- Norma -/
noncomputable def norm (v : Vec3 ℝ) : ℝ := sqrt (norm2 v)

/-- Normalizált vektor -/
noncomputable def normalized (v : Vec3 ℝ) (h : v ≠ 0) : Vec3 ℝ :=
  (1 / norm v) • v

/-! ## Keresztszorzat Tulajdonságok -/

theorem cross_anticomm (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : cross a b = -(cross b a) := by
  ext
  · simp only [cross, Neg.neg]
    ring
  · simp only [cross, Neg.neg]
    ring
  · simp only [cross, Neg.neg]
    ring

theorem cross_self_zero (a : Vec3 ℝ) : cross a a = 0 := by
  ext
  · simp only [cross, Zero.zero]
    ring
  · simp only [cross, Zero.zero]
    ring
  · simp only [cross, Zero.zero]
    ring

theorem cross_linear_left (r : ℝ) (a b : Vec3 ℝ) :
    cross (r • a) b = r • cross a b := by
  ext
  · simp only [cross, HMul.hMul, SMul.smul]
    ring
  · simp only [cross, HMul.hMul, SMul.smul]
    ring
  · simp only [cross, HMul.hMul, SMul.smul]
    ring

theorem cross_linear_right (r : ℝ) (a b : Vec3 ℝ) :
    cross a (r • b) = r • cross a b := by
  ext
  · simp only [cross, HMul.hMul, SMul.smul]
    ring
  · simp only [cross, HMul.hMul, SMul.smul]
    ring
  · simp only [cross, HMul.hMul, SMul.smul]
    ring

theorem cross_add_left (a b c : Vec3 ℝ) :
    cross (a + b) c = cross a c + cross b c := by
  ext
  · simp only [cross, Add.add]
    ring
  · simp only [cross, Add.add]
    ring
  · simp only [cross, Add.add]
    ring

theorem cross_add_right (a b c : Vec3 ℝ) :
    cross a (b + c) = cross a b + cross a c := by
  ext
  · simp only [cross, Add.add]
    ring
  · simp only [cross, Add.add]
    ring
  · simp only [cross, Add.add]
    ring

/-! ## Skalárszorzat Tulajdonságok -/

theorem dot_comm (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : dot a b = dot b a := by
  simp only [dot]
  ring

theorem dot_linear_left (r : ℝ) (a b : Vec3 ℝ) :
    dot (r • a) b = r * dot a b := by
  simp only [dot, HMul.hMul, SMul.smul]
  ring

theorem dot_linear_right (r : ℝ) (a b : Vec3 ℝ) :
    dot a (r • b) = r * dot a b := by
  simp only [dot, HMul.hMul, SMul.smul]
  ring

theorem dot_add_left (a b c : Vec3 ℝ) :
    dot (a + b) c = dot a c + dot b c := by
  simp only [dot, Add.add]
  ring

theorem dot_add_right (a b c : Vec3 ℝ) :
    dot a (b + c) = dot a b + dot a c := by
  simp only [dot, Add.add]
  ring

theorem dot_self_nonneg (v : Vec3 ℝ) : 0 ≤ dot v v := by
  simp only [dot]
  have hx : 0 ≤ v.x * v.x := sq_nonneg v.x
  have hy : 0 ≤ v.y * v.y := sq_nonneg v.y
  have hz : 0 ≤ v.z * v.z := sq_nonneg v.z
  linarith

theorem dot_self_eq_zero_iff (v : Vec3 ℝ) :
    dot v v = 0 ↔ v = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp only [dot] at h
    have : v.x * v.x + v.y * v.y + v.z * v.z = 0 := h
    have hx : v.x * v.x = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg v.x, sq_nonneg v.y, sq_nonneg v.z]
    have hy : v.y * v.y = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg v.x, sq_nonneg v.y, sq_nonneg v.z]
    have hz : v.z * v.z = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg v.x, sq_nonneg v.y, sq_nonneg v.z]
    have hx' : v.x = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg v.x]
    have hy' : v.y = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg v.y]
    have hz' : v.z = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg v.z]
    ext <;> assumption
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    simp only [dot, Zero.zero]
    ring

theorem dot_cross_self_left (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : dot a (cross a b) = 0 := by
  simp only [dot, cross]
  ring

theorem dot_cross_self_right (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : dot b (cross a b) = 0 := by
  simp only [dot, cross]
  ring

/-! ## Norma Tulajdonságok -/

theorem norm2_nonneg (v : Vec3 ℝ) : 0 ≤ norm2 v := by
  exact dot_self_nonneg v

theorem norm_nonneg (v : Vec3 ℝ) : 0 ≤ norm v := by
  exact sqrt_nonneg _

theorem norm2_zero_iff (v : Vec3 ℝ) : norm2 v = 0 ↔ v = 0 := by
  exact dot_self_eq_zero_iff v

theorem norm_zero_iff (v : Vec3 ℝ) : norm v = 0 ↔ v = 0 := by
  rw [norm, sqrt_eq_zero' (norm2_nonneg v), norm2_zero_iff]

theorem norm_pos_iff (v : Vec3 ℝ) : 0 < norm v ↔ v ≠ 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h hn
    rw [hn] at h
    simp only [norm, norm2, dot, Zero.zero] at h
    linarith [sqrt_nonneg (0 : ℝ)]
  · intro h
    have : norm v ≠ 0 := by rwa [norm_zero_iff]
    exact (norm_nonneg v).lt_of_ne (Ne.symm this)

theorem norm2_smul (r : ℝ) (v : Vec3 ℝ) :
    norm2 (r • v) = r^2 * norm2 v := by
  simp only [norm2, dot, HMul.hMul, SMul.smul]
  ring

theorem norm_smul (r : ℝ) (v : Vec3 ℝ) :
    norm (r • v) = |r| * norm v := by
  simp only [norm]
  rw [norm2_smul]
  rw [sqrt_sq_eq_abs, sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg r)]
  ring

theorem norm2_add (a b : Vec3 ℝ) :
    norm2 (a + b) = norm2 a + 2 * dot a b + norm2 b := by
  simp only [norm2, dot, Add.add]
  ring

theorem norm_triangle (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : norm (a + b) ≤ norm a + norm b := by
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · rw [ha]
    simp only [Zero.zero, zero_add]
    linarith [norm_nonneg a]
  by_cases hb : b = 0
  · rw [hb]
    simp only [Zero.zero, add_zero]
    linarith [norm_nonneg b]
  rw [norm, norm]
  have h1 : 0 ≤ norm2 (a + b) := norm2_nonneg _
  have h2 : 0 ≤ norm2 a := norm2_nonneg _
  have h3 : 0 ≤ norm2 b := norm2_nonneg _
  apply sqrt_le_sqrt at h1
  sorry -- Cauchy-Schwarz inequality needed from mathlib

theorem normalized_norm (v : Vec3 ℝ) (h : v ≠ 0) :
    norm (normalized v h) = 1 := by
  simp only [normalized, norm_smul]
  have : 0 < norm v := norm_pos_iff v |>.mpr h
  rw [abs_of_pos (one_div_pos.mpr this)]
  field_simp

end Vec3

/-! # Mátrix Műveletek és SVD -/

/-- Rotációs mátrix tulajdonság: ortogonális és determináns = 1 -/
def IsProperRotation (R : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) : Prop :=
  Rᵀ * R = 1 ∧ R.det = 1

/-- SVD létezése 3x3 mátrixra (mathlib-ből következik) -/
axiom svd_exists (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) :
  ∃ (U V : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (S : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ),
    A = U * S * Vᵀ ∧
    Uᵀ * U = 1 ∧
    Vᵀ * V = 1 ∧
    ∀ i j, i ≠ j → S i j = 0

/-- Ortogonális mátrix determinánsa ±1 -/
theorem orthogonal_det_eq_one_or_neg_one (Q : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (h : Qᵀ * Q = 1) : Q.det = 1 ∨ Q.det = -1 := by
  have : (Qᵀ * Q).det = (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ).det := by rw [h]
  rw [det_mul, det_transpose, det_one] at this
  have : Q.det * Q.det = 1 := this
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg Q.det]

/-- Tükrözés korrekciója -/
def correctReflection (U V : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hU : Uᵀ * U = 1) (hV : Vᵀ * V = 1) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  let R := V * Uᵀ
  if R.det < 0 then
    let V' := V * diagonal ![1, 1, -1]
    V' * Uᵀ
  else R

theorem correctReflection_is_proper_rotation (U V : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hU : Uᵀ * U = 1) (hV : Vᵀ * V = 1) :
    IsProperRotation (correctReflection U V hU hV) := by
  simp only [IsProperRotation, correctReflection]
  split_ifs with h
  · constructor
    · sorry -- Orthogonality preserved
    · sorry -- Determinant = 1
  · constructor
    · sorry -- Orthogonality
    · sorry -- Determinant already 1

/-! # RMSD Számítás -/

/-- Euklideszi távolság négyzete -/
def squaredDistance (p q : Vec3.Vec3 ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Vec3.norm2 (p - q)

/-- RMSD definíciója -/
noncomputable def rmsd (decoy gt : Fin n → Vec3.Vec3 ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sqrt ((1 / n) * ∑ i, squaredDistance (decoy i) (gt i))

theorem rmsd_nonneg (decoy gt : Fin n → Vec3.Vec3 ℝ) : 0 ≤ rmsd decoy gt := by
  exact sqrt_nonneg _

theorem rmsd_zero_iff (decoy gt : Fin n → Vec3.Vec3 ℝ) [NeZero n] :
    rmsd decoy gt = 0 ↔ decoy = gt := by
  simp only [rmsd, sqrt_eq_zero']
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : ∑ i, squaredDistance (decoy i) (gt i) = 0 := by
      have hn : (0 : ℝ) < n := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (NeZero.pos n)
      field_simp at h
      linarith
    sorry -- Sum of nonneg = 0 implies all terms = 0
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    simp only [squaredDistance, sub_self, Vec3.norm2, Vec3.dot, Zero.zero]
    ring

theorem rmsd_symm (x y : Fin n → Vec3.Vec3 ℝ) : rmsd x y = rmsd y x := by
  simp only [rmsd, squaredDistance]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  ext i
  rw [Vec3.norm2, Vec3.norm2]
  have : x i - y i = -(y i - x i) := by ring
  rw [this, Vec3.dot_linear_left, Vec3.dot_linear_right]
  ring

/-! # Softmax és Attention -/

/-- Softmax függvény -/
noncomputable def softmax (x : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin n → ℝ :=
  fun i => exp (x i) / ∑ j, exp (x j)

theorem softmax_nonneg (x : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) : 0 ≤ softmax x i := by
  simp only [softmax]
  apply div_nonneg
  · exact exp_pos _ |>.le
  · apply Finset.sum_pos
    · intro j _
      exact exp_pos _
    · exact Finset.univ_nonempty

theorem softmax_sum_one (x : Fin n → ℝ) : ∑ i, softmax x i = 1 := by
  simp only [softmax]
  rw [Finset.sum_div]
  have h : ∑ i, exp (x i) ≠ 0 := by
    apply ne_of_gt
    apply Finset.sum_pos
    · intro j _
      exact exp_pos _
    · exact Finset.univ_nonempty
  field_simp

theorem softmax_le_one (x : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) : softmax x i ≤ 1 := by
  have h1 : softmax x i ≤ ∑ j, softmax x j := Finset.single_le_sum (by simp [softmax_nonneg]) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  rw [softmax_sum_one] at h1
  exact h1

/-- Attention scores számítás (egyszerűsített) -/
noncomputable def attentionScores (Q K : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) (i : Fin n) : Fin n → ℝ :=
  fun j => ∑ k, Q i k * K j k

/-- Attention output -/
noncomputable def attentionOutput
    (weights : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (V : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin d) ℝ) : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin d) ℝ :=
  weights * V

theorem attentionOutput_shape (weights : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (V : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin d) ℝ) :
    ∃ out : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin d) ℝ, out = attentionOutput weights V := by
  exact ⟨attentionOutput weights V, rfl⟩

/-! # Mask Mean -/

/-- Maszkolt átlag -/
noncomputable def maskMean (mask : Fin n → ℝ) (values : Fin n → ℝ) (eps : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let numerator := ∑ i, mask i * values i
  let denominator := max (∑ i, mask i) eps
  numerator / denominator

theorem maskMean_with_positive_mask
    (mask : Fin n → ℝ) (values : Fin n → ℝ) (eps : ℝ)
    (heps : 0 < eps)
    (hmask : ∀ i, 0 ≤ mask i) :
    ∃ result, result = maskMean mask values eps := by
  exact ⟨maskMean mask values eps, rfl⟩

/-! # Típusbiztonság és Prekondíciók -/

/-- Biztonságos mátrix szorzás dimenzióellenőrzéssel -/
def safeMatMul {m n p : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) ℝ) :
    { C : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℝ // C = A * B } :=
  ⟨A * B, rfl⟩

/-- Biztonságos normalizálás -/
noncomputable def safeNormalize (v : Vec3.Vec3 ℝ) (h : v ≠ 0) :
    { u : Vec3.Vec3 ℝ // Vec3.norm u = 1 ∧ ∃ r > 0, v = r • u } :=
  ⟨Vec3.normalized v h,
   ⟨Vec3.normalized_norm v h,
    ⟨Vec3.norm v, Vec3.norm_pos_iff v |>.mpr h, by
      simp only [Vec3.normalized]
      rw [← mul_smul, mul_one_div_cancel, one_smul]
      exact (Vec3.norm_pos_iff v |>.mpr h).ne'⟩⟩⟩

end ProteinVerification

theorem norm_pos_iff_ne_zero (v : Vec3 ℝ) : 0 < norm v ↔ v ≠ 0 := by
  rw [lt_iff_le_and_ne]
  simp [norm_nonneg, Ne.symm (norm_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero v)]

theorem norm2_smul (r : ℝ) (v : Vec3 ℝ) : norm2 (r • v) = r^2 * norm2 v := by
  rw [norm2, dot_smul_left, dot_smul_right, mul_comm]
  ring

theorem norm_smul (r : ℝ) (v : Vec3 ℝ) : norm (r • v) = |r| * norm v := by
  rw [norm, norm2_smul, sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg r), sqrt_sq_eq_abs, norm]

theorem norm2_add (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : norm2 (a + b) = norm2 a + 2 * dot a b + norm2 b := by
  rw [norm2_eq_dot_self, dot_add_left, dot_add_right, dot_add_right, dot_comm b a]
  ring

theorem cauchy_schwarz (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : |dot a b| ≤ norm a * norm b := by
  by_cases h : b = 0
  · rw [h]; simp
  · have h1 : (norm b)^2 > 0 := by
      rw [← sq_pos_iff]
      exact norm_pos_iff_ne_zero b |>.mpr h
    let lambda := dot a b / (norm b)^2
    have h2 : 0 ≤ norm2 (a - lambda • b) := norm2_nonneg _
    rw [norm2_add] at h2
    simp only [norm2_smul, norm2, norm_smul, norm_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero, norm2_eq_dot_self,
      dot_smul_right, dot_neg_right, dot_smul_left, dot_neg_left, neg_add_rev, smul_neg] at h2
    field_simp at h2
    rw [div_le_iff h1]
    exact h2

theorem norm_triangle_inequality (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : norm (a + b) ≤ norm a + norm b := by
  have : (norm (a + b))^2 ≤ (norm a + norm b)^2 := by
    rw [← norm2]
    rw [norm2_add]
    have := cauchy_schwarz a b
    have h_dot_le : dot a b ≤ |dot a b| := le_abs_self _
    have h_le := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this (by norm_num)
    rw [← norm2] at h_le
    rw [norm, norm]
    nlinarith
  exact nonneg_le_nonneg_of_sq_le_sq (norm_nonneg (a+b)) (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg a) (norm_nonneg b)) this

theorem normalized_norm_is_one (v : Vec3 ℝ) (h : v ≠ 0) : norm (normalized v h) = 1 := by
  rw [normalized, norm_smul, abs_of_pos, mul_div_cancel_left]
  · exact (norm_pos_iff_ne_zero v).mpr h
  · exact one_div_pos.mpr ((norm_pos_iff_ne_zero v).mpr h)

theorem square_euclidean_distance_nonneg (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : 0 ≤ square_euclidean_distance a b :=
  norm2_nonneg _

theorem euclidean_distance_nonneg (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : 0 ≤ euclidean_distance a b :=
  norm_nonneg _

theorem square_euclidean_distance_zero_iff (a b : Vec3 ℝ) :
    square_euclidean_distance a b = 0 ↔ a = b := by
  rw [square_euclidean_distance, norm2_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero]

theorem euclidean_distance_zero_iff (a b : Vec3 ℝ) :
    euclidean_distance a b = 0 ↔ a = b := by
  rw [euclidean_distance, norm_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero]

theorem euclidean_distance_symm (a b : Vec3 ℝ) :
    euclidean_distance a b = euclidean_distance b a := by
  rw [euclidean_distance, euclidean_distance, ← norm_neg (a-b), neg_sub]

noncomputable def dihedral_angle (p1 p2 p3 p4 : Vec3 ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let b1 := p1 - p2
  let b2 := p3 - p2
  let b3 := p4 - p3
  let n1 := cross b1 b2
  let n2 := cross b3 b2
  let m1 := cross n1 n2
  atan2 (dot m1 (normalized b2 (by sorry))) (dot n1 n2)

end Vec3

def IsProperRotation (R : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) : Prop := Rᵀ * R = 1 ∧ R.det = 1

theorem orthogonal_det_pm_one (R : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (h : Rᵀ * R = 1) :
    R.det = 1 ∨ R.det = -1 := by
  have := (Rᵀ * R).det
  rw [h, det_one] at this
  rw [det_mul, det_transpose] at this
  exact sq_eq_one_iff.mp this

def correct_reflection (V U : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (allow_reflection : Bool) :
    Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  let R := V * Uᵀ
  if ¬allow_reflection ∧ R.det < 0 then
    let V' := V * (diagonal ![1, 1, -1])
    V' * Uᵀ
  else
    R

noncomputable def transform_ls (x y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin 3) ℝ) (allow_reflection : Bool) :
    Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  let c := xᵀ * y
  let F := svd c
  correct_reflection F.V F.U allow_reflection

noncomputable def align_coords (x y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (x_indices y_indices : Fin m → Fin n) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  let x_subset := fun i => x (x_indices i)
  let y_subset := fun i => y (y_indices i)
  let x_mean := (1 / m) • ∑ i, x_subset i
  let y_mean := (1 / m) • ∑ i, y_subset i
  let cx := fun i => x i - x_mean
  let cy := fun i => y i - y_mean
  let cx_subset := fun i => cx (x_indices i)
  let cy_subset := fun i => cy (y_indices i)
  let R := transform_ls cx_subset cy_subset false
  fun i => (cx i).toMatrix * R + y_mean.toMatrix

noncomputable def rmsd (decoy gt : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin 3) ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sqrt ((1 / n) * (∑ i, Vec3.square_euclidean_distance (decoy i) (gt i)))

theorem rmsd_nonneg (decoy gt : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin 3) ℝ) : 0 ≤ rmsd decoy gt :=
  sqrt_nonneg _

theorem rmsd_zero_iff [NeZero n] (decoy gt : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    rmsd decoy gt = 0 ↔ decoy = gt := by
  rw [rmsd, sqrt_eq_zero', mul_eq_zero, inv_eq_zero]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with h' | h'
    · contradiction
    · rw [sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg] at h'
      · funext i
        rw [Vec3.square_euclidean_distance_zero_iff]
        exact h' i (by simp)
      · intro i
        exact Vec3.square_euclidean_distance_nonneg _ _
  · intro h; rw [h]; simp

noncomputable def softmax (x : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin n → ℝ :=
  fun i => exp (x i) / ∑ j, exp (x j)

theorem softmax_output_nonneg (x : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) : 0 ≤ softmax x i :=
  div_nonneg (exp_pos _).le (sum_nonneg (fun j _ => (exp_pos _).le))

theorem softmax_sum_is_one [NeZero n] (x : Fin n → ℝ) : ∑ i, softmax x i = 1 := by
  have h_denom_ne_zero : ∑ j, exp (x j) ≠ 0 := by
    apply ne_of_gt
    exact sum_pos (fun j _ => exp_pos _) univ_nonempty
  rw [softmax, sum_div, div_self h_denom_ne_zero]

noncomputable def attention_scores (q k : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ :=
  (1 / sqrt d) • (q * kᵀ)

noncomputable def attention_output (weights : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (v : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ :=
  weights * v

noncomputable def mask_mean (mask value : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (eps : ℝ) :
    Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ :=
  (value * mask) / (max (sum mask) eps)

end ProteinVerification

import Mathlib.Data.Real.Sqrt
import Mathlib.Data.Fin.Basic

structure Vec3 (α : Type*) where
  x : α
  y : α
  z : α
deriving DecidableEq

namespace Vec3

variable {α : Type*}

theorem ext {v w : Vec3 α} (hx : v.x = w.x) (hy : v.y = w.y) (hz : v.z = w.z) : v = w := by
  cases v; cases w; cases hx; cases hy; cases hz; rfl

instance [Add α] : Add (Vec3 α) where
  add v w := ⟨v.x + w.x, v.y + w.y, v.z + w.z⟩

instance [Sub α] : Sub (Vec3 α) where
  sub v w := ⟨v.x - w.x, v.y - w.y, v.z - w.z⟩

instance [Mul α] : HMul α (Vec3 α) (Vec3 α) where
  hMul s v := ⟨s * v.x, s * v.y, s * v.z⟩

instance [Zero α] : Zero (Vec3 α) where
  zero := ⟨0, 0, 0⟩

instance [Neg α] : Neg (Vec3 α) where
  neg v := ⟨-v.x, -v.y, -v.z⟩

def cross [Ring α] (a b : Vec3 α) : Vec3 α :=
  ⟨a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y, a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z, a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x⟩

def dot [Mul α] [Add α] (a b : Vec3 α) : α :=
  a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z

def norm2 (v : Vec3 ℝ) : ℝ := dot v v

noncomputable def norm (v : Vec3 ℝ) : ℝ := sqrt (norm2 v)

noncomputable def normalized (v : Vec3 ℝ) (h : v ≠ 0) : Vec3 ℝ := (1 / norm v) • v

def square_euclidean_distance (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : ℝ := norm2 (a - b)

noncomputable def euclidean_distance (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : ℝ := norm (a - b)

theorem cross_anticomm (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : cross a b = -(cross b a) := by
  apply ext
  all_goals
    change _ = -_
    ring

theorem cross_self (a : Vec3 ℝ) : cross a a = 0 := by
  apply ext
  all_goals
    change _ = (0:ℝ)
    ring

theorem cross_smul_left (r : ℝ) (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : cross (r • a) b = r • cross a b := by
  apply ext
  all_goals
    change _ = _
    ring

theorem cross_smul_right (r : ℝ) (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : cross a (r • b) = r • cross a b := by
  apply ext
  all_goals
    change _ = _
    ring

theorem cross_add_left (a b c : Vec3 ℝ) : cross (a + b) c = cross a c + cross b c := by
  apply ext
  all_goals
    change _ = _
    ring

theorem cross_add_right (a b c : Vec3 ℝ) : cross a (b + c) = cross a b + cross a c := by
  apply ext
  all_goals
    change _ = _
    ring

theorem dot_comm (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : dot a b = dot b a := by
  change _ = _
  ring

theorem dot_add_left (a b c : Vec3 ℝ) : dot (a + b) c = dot a c + dot b c := by
  change _ = _
  ring

theorem dot_add_right (a b c : Vec3 ℝ) : dot a (b + c) = dot a b + dot a c := by
  change _ = _
  ring

theorem dot_smul_left (r : ℝ) (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : dot (r • a) b = r * dot a b := by
  change _ = _
  ring

theorem dot_smul_right (r : ℝ) (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : dot a (r • b) = r * dot a b := by
  change _ = _
  ring

theorem dot_self_nonneg (v : Vec3 ℝ) : 0 ≤ dot v v := by
  change 0 ≤ v.x^2 + v.y^2 + v.z^2
  have hx : 0 ≤ v.x^2 := by exact sq_nonneg v.x
  have hy : 0 ≤ v.y^2 := by exact sq_nonneg v.y
  have hz : 0 ≤ v.z^2 := by exact sq_nonneg v.z
  linarith

theorem dot_self_eq_zero_iff (v : Vec3 ℝ) : dot v v = 0 ↔ v = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    change v.x^2 + v.y^2 + v.z^2 = 0 at h
    have hx : v.x = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg v.x, sq_nonneg v.y, sq_nonneg v.z]
    have hy : v.y = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg v.x, sq_nonneg v.y, sq_nonneg v.z]
    have hz : v.z = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg v.x, sq_nonneg v.y, sq_nonneg v.z]
    apply ext hx hy hz
  · intro h
    cases h
    change 0 + 0 + 0 = (0:ℝ)
    ring

theorem norm2_nonneg (v : Vec3 ℝ) : 0 ≤ norm2 v := dot_self_nonneg v

theorem norm_nonneg (v : Vec3 ℝ) : 0 ≤ norm v := sqrt_nonneg _

theorem norm_eq_zero_iff (v : Vec3 ℝ) : norm v = 0 ↔ v = 0 := by
  change sqrt (dot v v) = 0 ↔ v = 0
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' := (sqrt_eq_zero').1 h
    exact (dot_self_eq_zero_iff v).1 h'
  · intro h
    cases h
    change sqrt 0 = (0:ℝ)
    exact rfl

theorem dot_cross_self_left (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : dot a (cross a b) = 0 := by
  change _ = (0:ℝ)
  ring

theorem dot_cross_self_right (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : dot b (cross a b) = 0 := by
  change _ = (0:ℝ)
  ring

end Vec3

noncomputable def rmsd {n : ℕ} (decoy gt : Fin n → Vec3.Vec3 ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sqrt ((1 / (n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, Vec3.square_euclidean_distance (decoy i) (gt i))

theorem rmsd_nonneg {n : ℕ} (decoy gt : Fin n → Vec3.Vec3 ℝ) : 0 ≤ rmsd decoy gt := by
  exact sqrt_nonneg _

theorem rmsd_symm {n : ℕ} (x y : Fin n → Vec3.Vec3 ℝ) : rmsd x y = rmsd y x := by
  unfold rmsd
  have : (fun i => Vec3.square_euclidean_distance (x i) (y i))
        = (fun i => Vec3.square_euclidean_distance (y i) (x i)) := by
    funext i
    change Vec3.norm2 (x i - y i) = Vec3.norm2 (y i - x i)
    have : y i - x i = -(x i - y i) := by
      apply Vec3.ext rfl rfl rfl
    change Vec3.dot (y i - x i) (y i - x i) = Vec3.dot (x i - y i) (x i - y i)
    ring
  exact rfl

theorem rmsd_zero_iff {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (decoy gt : Fin n → Vec3.Vec3 ℝ) :
    rmsd decoy gt = 0 ↔ decoy = gt := by
  unfold rmsd
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h0 : (1 / (n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, Vec3.square_euclidean_distance (decoy i) (gt i) = 0 := by
      exact (sqrt_eq_zero').1 h
    have hn : (1 / (n:ℝ)) ≠ 0 := by
      have : (n:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
        have : 0 < (n:ℝ) := by
          have : 0 < (n:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (NeZero.pos _))
          exact this
        exact ne_of_gt this
      field_simp [this]
    have : ∑ i, Vec3.square_euclidean_distance (decoy i) (gt i) = 0 := by
      field_simp [hn] at h0
      exact by exact h0
    have hnonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Vec3.square_euclidean_distance (decoy i) (gt i) := by
      intro i
      exact Vec3.norm2_nonneg _
    have hAllZero : ∀ i, Vec3.square_euclidean_distance (decoy i) (gt i) = 0 := by
      intro i
      have := sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hnonneg |>.1 this
      exact this i (mem_univ i)
    funext i
    have := hAllZero i
    change decoy i = gt i
    have := (Vec3.square_euclidean_distance_zero_iff (decoy i) (gt i)).1 this
    exact this
  · intro h
    cases h
    change sqrt ((1 / (n:ℝ)) * ∑ i, Vec3.square_euclidean_distance (decoy i) (decoy i)) = (0:ℝ)
    have : ∑ i, Vec3.square_euclidean_distance (decoy i) (decoy i) = 0 := by
      apply sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
      intro i
      exact Vec3.norm2_nonneg _
    change sqrt ((1 / (n:ℝ)) * 0) = (0:ℝ)
    change sqrt 0 = (0:ℝ)
    exact rfl

noncomputable def softmax {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (x : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin n → ℝ :=
  fun i => exp (x i) / (∑ j, exp (x j))

theorem softmax_nonneg {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (x : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) : 0 ≤ softmax x i := by
  unfold softmax
  have hpos : 0 < ∑ j, exp (x j) := by
    exact sum_pos (fun j _ => exp_pos _) univ_nonempty
  exact div_nonneg (le_of_lt (exp_pos _)) (le_of_lt hpos)

theorem softmax_sum_one {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (x : Fin n → ℝ) : ∑ i, softmax x i = 1 := by
  unfold softmax
  have hpos : 0 < ∑ j, exp (x j) := by
    exact sum_pos (fun j _ => exp_pos _) univ_nonempty
  have hne : ∑ j, exp (x j) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hpos
  have : ∑ i, exp (x i) / (∑ j, exp (x j)) = (∑ i, exp (x i)) / (∑ j, exp (x j)) := by
    exact sum_div
  have hsum : (∑ i, exp (x i)) / (∑ j, exp (x j)) = 1 := by
    field_simp [hne]
  exact this.trans hsum

noncomputable def attentionScores {n d : ℕ} (Q K : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) :
    Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ :=
  Q * Kᵀ

noncomputable def attentionOutput {n d : ℕ}
    (weights : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) :
    Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ :=
  weights * V

theorem attentionOutput_shape {n d : ℕ}
    (weights : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) :
    ∃ out : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ, out = attentionOutput weights V := by
  exact ⟨attentionOutput weights V, rfl⟩

end ProteinVerification

import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Real.Sqrt
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith

namespace ProteinVerification

structure Vec3 (α : Type*) where
  x : α
  y : α
  z : α
deriving DecidableEq

namespace Vec3

variable {α : Type*}

theorem ext {v w : Vec3 α} (hx : v.x = w.x) (hy : v.y = w.y) (hz : v.z = w.z) : v = w := by
  cases v; cases w; cases hx; cases hy; cases hz; rfl

instance [Add α] : Add (Vec3 α) where
  add v w := ⟨v.x + w.x, v.y + w.y, v.z + w.z⟩

instance [Sub α] : Sub (Vec3 α) where
  sub v w := ⟨v.x - w.x, v.y - w.y, v.z - w.z⟩

instance [Zero α] : Zero (Vec3 α) where
  zero := ⟨0, 0, 0⟩

instance [Neg α] : Neg (Vec3 α) where
  neg v := ⟨-v.x, -v.y, -v.z⟩

instance [Mul α] : SMul α (Vec3 α) where
  smul s v := ⟨s * v.x, s * v.y, s * v.z⟩

def cross [Ring α] (a b : Vec3 α) : Vec3 α :=
  ⟨a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y, a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z, a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x⟩

def dot [Mul α] [Add α] (a b : Vec3 α) : α :=
  a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z

def norm2 (v : Vec3 ℝ) : ℝ := dot v v

noncomputable def norm (v : Vec3 ℝ) : ℝ := Real.sqrt (norm2 v)

def square_euclidean_distance (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : ℝ := norm2 (a - b)

noncomputable def euclidean_distance (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : ℝ := norm (a - b)

theorem add_def [Add α] (v w : Vec3 α) :
    v + w = ⟨v.x + w.x, v.y + w.y, v.z + w.z⟩ := rfl

theorem sub_def [Sub α] (v w : Vec3 α) :
    v - w = ⟨v.x - w.x, v.y - w.y, v.z - w.z⟩ := rfl

theorem neg_def [Neg α] (v : Vec3 α) :
    -v = ⟨-v.x, -v.y, -v.z⟩ := rfl

theorem zero_def [Zero α] : (0 : Vec3 α) = ⟨0,0,0⟩ := rfl

theorem smul_def [Mul α] (s : α) (v : Vec3 α) :
    s • v = ⟨s * v.x, s * v.y, s * v.z⟩ := rfl

theorem cross_anticomm (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : cross a b = -(cross b a) := by
  apply ext
  all_goals
    change _ = -_
    ring

theorem cross_self (a : Vec3 ℝ) : cross a a = 0 := by
  apply ext
  all_goals
    change _ = (0:ℝ)
    ring

theorem cross_add_left (a b c : Vec3 ℝ) :
    cross (a + b) c = cross a c + cross b c := by
  apply ext
  all_goals
    change _ = _
    ring

theorem cross_add_right (a b c : Vec3 ℝ) :
    cross a (b + c) = cross a b + cross a c := by
  apply ext
  all_goals
    change _ = _
    ring

theorem cross_smul_left (r : ℝ) (a b : Vec3 ℝ) :
    cross (r • a) b = r • cross a b := by
  apply ext
  all_goals
    change _ = _
    ring

theorem cross_smul_right (r : ℝ) (a b : Vec3 ℝ) :
    cross a (r • b) = r • cross a b := by
  apply ext
  all_goals
    change _ = _
    ring

theorem dot_comm (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : dot a b = dot b a := by
  change _ = _
  ring

theorem dot_add_left (a b c : Vec3 ℝ) :
    dot (a + b) c = dot a c + dot b c := by
  change _ = _
  ring

theorem dot_add_right (a b c : Vec3 ℝ) :
    dot a (b + c) = dot a b + dot a c := by
  change _ = _
  ring

theorem dot_smul_left (r : ℝ) (a b : Vec3 ℝ) :
    dot (r • a) b = r * dot a b := by
  change _ = _
  ring

theorem dot_smul_right (r : ℝ) (a b : Vec3 ℝ) :
    dot a (r • b) = r * dot a b := by
  change _ = _
  ring

theorem dot_self_nonneg (v : Vec3 ℝ) : 0 ≤ dot v v := by
  change 0 ≤ v.x^2 + v.y^2 + v.z^2
  have hx : 0 ≤ v.x^2 := by exact sq_nonneg v.x
  have hy : 0 ≤ v.y^2 := by exact sq_nonneg v.y
  have hz : 0 ≤ v.z^2 := by exact sq_nonneg v.z
  linarith

theorem dot_self_eq_zero_iff (v : Vec3 ℝ) : dot v v = 0 ↔ v = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hx : 0 ≤ v.x^2 := by exact sq_nonneg v.x
    have hy : 0 ≤ v.y^2 := by exact sq_nonneg v.y
    have hz : 0 ≤ v.z^2 := by exact sq_nonneg v.z
    have hsum : v.x^2 + v.y^2 + v.z^2 = 0 := by simpa using h
    have hx0 : v.x^2 = 0 := by linarith
    have hy0 : v.y^2 = 0 := by linarith
    have hz0 : v.z^2 = 0 := by linarith
    have hx' : v.x = 0 := by
      have := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hx0
      exact this
    have hy' : v.y = 0 := by
      have := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hy0
      exact this
    have hz' : v.z = 0 := by
      have := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hz0
      exact this
    exact ext hx' hy' hz'
  · intro h
    cases h
    change 0 + 0 + 0 = (0:ℝ)
    ring

theorem norm2_nonneg (v : Vec3 ℝ) : 0 ≤ norm2 v := dot_self_nonneg v

theorem norm_nonneg (v : Vec3 ℝ) : 0 ≤ norm v := Real.sqrt_nonneg _

theorem norm_eq_zero_iff (v : Vec3 ℝ) : norm v = 0 ↔ v = 0 := by
  change Real.sqrt (dot v v) = 0 ↔ v = 0
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' := (Real.sqrt_eq_zero').1 h
    exact (dot_self_eq_zero_iff v).1 h'
  · intro h
    cases h
    change Real.sqrt 0 = (0:ℝ)
    rfl

theorem square_euclidean_distance_nonneg (a b : Vec3 ℝ) :
    0 ≤ square_euclidean_distance a b := norm2_nonneg _

theorem euclidean_distance_nonneg (a b : Vec3 ℝ) :
    0 ≤ euclidean_distance a b := norm_nonneg _

theorem square_euclidean_distance_zero_iff (a b : Vec3 ℝ) :
    square_euclidean_distance a b = 0 ↔ a = b := by
  change dot (a - b) (a - b) = 0 ↔ a = b
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := (dot_self_eq_zero_iff (a - b)).1 h
    have hx : (a - b).x = 0 := by
      cases this; rfl
    have hy : (a - b).y = 0 := by
      cases this; rfl
    have hz : (a - b).z = 0 := by
      cases this; rfl
    have e1 : a.x = b.x := by
      change a.x - b.x = 0 at hx
      linarith
    have e2 : a.y = b.y := by
      change a.y - b.y = 0 at hy
      linarith
    have e3 : a.z = b.z := by
      change a.z - b.z = 0 at hz
      linarith
    exact ext e1 e2 e3
  · intro h
    cases h
    change dot 0 0 = (0:ℝ)
    change 0 + 0 + 0 = (0:ℝ)
    ring

theorem euclidean_distance_zero_iff (a b : Vec3 ℝ) :
    euclidean_distance a b = 0 ↔ a = b := by
  change Real.sqrt (dot (a - b) (a - b)) = 0 ↔ a = b
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' := (Real.sqrt_eq_zero').1 h
    exact (square_euclidean_distance_zero_iff a b).1 h'
  · intro h
    cases h
    change Real.sqrt 0 = (0:ℝ)
    rfl

theorem euclidean_distance_symm (a b : Vec3 ℝ) :
    euclidean_distance a b = euclidean_distance b a := by
  change Real.sqrt (dot (a - b) (a - b)) = Real.sqrt (dot (b - a) (b - a))
  have hx : b - a = -(a - b) := by
    apply ext
    all_goals
      change _ = -_
      ring
  have : dot (b - a) (b - a) = dot (a - b) (a - b) := by
    change (b.x - a.x)^2 + (b.y - a.y)^2 + (b.z - a.z)^2
        = (a.x - b.x)^2 + (a.y - b.y)^2 + (a.z - b.z)^2
    ring
  exact congrArg Real.sqrt this

theorem dot_cross_self_left (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : dot a (cross a b) = 0 := by
  change _ = (0:ℝ)
  ring

theorem dot_cross_self_right (a b : Vec3 ℝ) : dot b (cross a b) = 0 := by
  change _ = (0:ℝ)
  ring

end Vec3

end ProteinVerification
